svg.text: Everyday English - Quote
Clarity is the byproduct of
effort, not luck.
MEANING
Understanding is achieved through hard work and
preparation, not by chance.
SYNONYMS
Understanding takes deliberate work.; Clear
thinking comes from sustained effort. · Similar
expressions for the idea, not word-for-word
equivalents.
IN CONTEXT
After checking the assumptions together, Maya
said, "Clarity is the byproduct of effort, not luck."
USAGE NOTE
Use this to emphasize that results require
intentional action. It is a reminder that you must
put in the work to reach a clear conclusion.
CONVERSATION
A: How did you finish the plan so fast?
B: Clarity is the byproduct of effort, not luck.
A: You spent all night on it?
B: Yes, but now the path is clear.
YOUR TURN
Explain the quote in your own words.
Model Answer: It means that you only reach a clear
understanding by working hard, not by hoping
things go well.
